items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I remember when you were during that when I heard you in 1976 with Hank Jones in a duo. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yes, yes.

ctx.x: And actually, it is -- that particular note is higher than a little violin can do normally. That is what I performed with the Binghamton Symphony and even during rehearsal, I meant to say that when I was reaching for this note, towards the end, I would ask one of the violins to copy me and do you know that when I made this squeak D, the violinist was unable to make that note -- duplicate that note on his little violin?
Yeah, I remember when you were during that when I heard you in 1976 with Hank Jones in a duo.
